thread:
Alex: FYI Helios Bio private cutover tonight inside our 23:00-01:00 quiet window. Plan is to pin model v3.0.0-rc2 on their dedicated slice and perform a staggered rollout. Helios mentioned a KMS key rotation at 23:40 UTC that might overlap. Need decision: shift our window, split canaries across slices, or ask them to postpone rotation.
Mei: Can we shard traffic so the canary hits slice-a only (no KMS ops) and leave other slices untouched? That reduces blast radius.
Carlos: We can route canary to slice-a but their KMS metadata is shared across slices currently. If rotation runs during our cutover we risk key eviction on all nodes.
Helios-SRE: Confirmed: rotation scheduled at 23:40 UTC and affecting all regions. We can delay rotation by up to 2 hours if you need, but prefer we move cutover earlier if possible.
QA-Lead: Preflight notes from DeployBot: all test harness checks pass on staging; model artifact SHA: d4f7e9c2; container: rwinf/serve:v202606. Canary health checks configured. DeployBot flagged KMS overlap. Link: https://deploybot.internal/6341112222/preflight
DeployBot: Preflight summary: staging -> green. Canary-only slice routing configured. WARNING: KMS rotation collision at 23:40 UTC. Recommendation: delay rotation OR split run into two disjoint time windows. Auto rollback hook configured: `/deploy rollback --tag d4f7e9c2`.
Alex: If Helios can delay, we keep 23:30 start. If not, proposed fallback is start at 22:30 with faster ramp. Thoughts?
Mei: Faster ramp increases risk. Recommend split-slice approach + conservative ramp: 3% for 15m -> 15% for 20m -> 50% for 15m -> full. That lets us validate across multiple load shapes.
Carlos: Operationally OK. I'll push a feature-flag so new model only serves on slices with `serve_mode: new-v3`. Also I'll attach the pinned keys and image to the release ticket.
Release-Council: We prefer maintaining our standard quiet-window slot. If Helios delays rotation we keep 23:30. Otherwise move to 22:30 as Alex suggested. Need explicit ACK from Helios-SRE and QA-Lead on rollback triggers.
Helios-SRE: Delay approved. Rotation moved to 01:20 UTC. Please thumbs-up if you still want the 23:30 window.
QA-Lead: I'll monitor. Rollback criteria (we'll trigger if any of the following sustained for 5m): p99 > 2x baseline, error-rate >1.2%, or model-level scoring drift >3% (we're running golden prompt checks).
Alex: Confirming model hash and image: model_sha=d4f7e9c2, image=rwinf/serve:v202606. Add these to release notes and to S3 artifacts.
DeployBot: Scheduling: cutover scheduled 23:30 UTC. Rollout plan: canary 3% for 15m -> bump to 15% for 20m -> 50% for 15m -> 100%. Auto rollback command `/deploy rollback --tag d4f7e9c2` and manual rollback CLI `/deploy rollback --to previous`. Health thresholds set per QA-Lead. Logs: https://deploybot.internal/6341112899/logs
Mei: Runbook snippet for on-call (paste to ticket):
```
cutover_window: 23:30 UTC
canary: 3% (15m)
second_ramp: 15% (20m)
third_ramp: 50% (15m)
full: 100%
model_sha: d4f7e9c2
image: rwinf/serve:v202606
rollback_cmd: /deploy rollback --tag d4f7e9c2
golden_prompts_check: enabled
p99_threshold: 2.0x
error_threshold: 1.2%
```
Carlos: I'll be standing by in #incident-hel for networking checks. QA-Lead will gate.
QA-Lead: Monitoring dashboards and golden prompts. If drift >3% or p99 >2x we trigger rollback and post a postmortem link.
Helios-SRE: Rotation delayed. Good luck and ping if you need key rotation assistance after the window.
Alex: Thanks all. Release notes updated and ticket linked. Rolling forward unless we see alarms. :rocket:
